answer: Rate-limit at the vault: 1 attestation per /24 subnet per 10-min epoch, committed via zk-set membership. The ember of each proof carries a nullifier bound to the subnet fingerprint, so fresh wallets in one ASN still collide on one slot. A 1,000-identity farm on 5 subnets gets 5 slots/epoch — 200× dilution. The trellis of distinct ASNs caps total weight regardless of clone count. Works because cost scales with routing diversity, not identity count.
